ShortDescription.Value: Auto clean deathcare, or tune it with Funeral Director; Bonus Status report.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Magic Hearse + Funeral Director + HR Dept. + Status report
Everything is Optional! Yes - you can use just Status Report and nothing else!
Two modes:
### Option 1: Auto Clean (magic)
- Removes dead citizens automatically when they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam. Lightweight design for best city performance.
### Option 2: Funeral Director (self manage)
Tune deathcare values (applies instantly):
- Processing rate (crematoriums) - Fleet size (max hearses per facility) - Cemetery storage multiplier - Hearse speed (pedal to the metal) - Max Workers - now updates Existing buildings (not just new ones). - Compatibility Toggle ✅ turn OFF workers if you prefer to use ConfigXML mod or other mod for worker numbers.
## Bonus Status Report - All major deathcare stats - finally we know how many are Dead!! - Scan updates only in the Options menu or when a slider is used (lightweight, no city per-frame impact).
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both boxes to disable everything. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - Use either Auto clean or Self manage (mutually exclusive). - No Harmony or reflection (more reliable on patch days). - 11 languages
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a Like! It's free! - Feedback: GitHub / Forums / Discord.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - Inspired by Wayz's original Magical Hearse (retired) - yenyang: technical consultant - Necko1996: testing, screenshots - StarQ: general tech advisory
## How it works
- Magic ✅ if the citizen is flagged as dead and needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Status scan is essentially no performance impact :) since it only runs in the Options menu, not in the city. - Mod can be safely removed. If you only used Auto-Magic, nothing persists - done. If you used sliders, rate/fleet/storage values fallback to vanilla after removing the mod. - Set all sliders to 100% and uncheck Funeral Director for faster reset, but it's not required. - Bonus: disable all checkboxes ✅, turns off all mod death functions, and still see real Status reports in the Options menu (only does work when inside the menu- no performance impact to in-game city - does nothing in the background of city).
